sources.primary_title: HP Delivers Measurable Progress in Saudi Arabia Across AI Innovation, Local Manufacturing and Future Skills
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, HP announced that its Riyadh manufacturing facility, which opened in October 2025, has successfully transitioned into ongoing commercial production. The facility is now actively producing and shipping locally manufactured HP products to customers across Saudi Arabia. This milestone represents a significant step in supporting Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 ambitions by scaling local production and strengthening supply-chain localization. Fadle Saad, Managing Director of MENA Regional Headquarters at HP Inc., emphasized that this move from commitment to delivery is helping build a more innovative, technology-led economy. The facility's operations are set to continue scaling throughout 2026, alongside efforts to grow relationships with Saudi suppliers and develop local manufacturing talent. This distinct manufacturing angle highlights tangible progress in the Kingdom's localization initiatives.
